findings.title: WHO warns of sharp rise in suspected meningitis cases among children in Gaza
findings.affected_population_system: Meningitis diagnostic and outbreak response capacity, particularly for children; WAFA attributes to WHO a statement that essential laboratory supplies and equipment remain barred from entering Gaza.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: essential laboratory supplies and equipment needed to respond to the outbreak remain barred from entering Gaza
findings.source_type: News agency reporting attributed to WHO statement

bounded_discovery_context.method: Direct WAFA article, comparison with November 26 OCHA report and all existing November 26–27 watch entries.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: Prior ledger covers limited laboratory confirmation and protocol training; explicit reported entry restriction on outbreak laboratory supplies is a substantive follow-up, not a newly imposed restriction.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: WAFA displays 12:47 PM on November 27 without explicit timezone; direct WHO statement not recovered, regional WHO site inaccessible. Older case counts not repeated; date refers to reported warning, onset of restriction unknown.
